source.note: Extracted by engine/adapters/clash_royale/extract_reference.py. Regenerate with a newer pass rather than editing this file by hand.

screens.name: Clash Royale-style main menu
screens.purpose: Main hub screen for a mobile battle card game, showing currency, trophies, battle arena preview, and navigation to battle, shop, cards, and clan features.
screens.why: the main/home screen - this is where a run starts and returns to

screens.name: Collection - Card/Troop list (Clash Royale)
screens.purpose: Shows the player's collection of cards/troops, including locked cards (with arena unlock requirements) and tower troops, with currency totals and a claim button at top. Bottom navigation bar switches between game sections.
screens.why: the card/troop collection screen, browse-only

screens.name: Market / Shop screen
screens.purpose: Lets the player view and purchase daily card deals, chests, and other in-game items using in-game currency (coins/gems).
screens.why: the Market/Shop screen - a real-money purchase flow (coins, gems, chests, cards for sale), and the single thing this run must never be on. The Shop tab is denylisted, so arriving here means something got past the guard
a social/clan screen. The Clan tab is denylisted, so arriving here means a vetted action reached a screen the guard was supposed to make unreachable

screens.name: Social tab / clan & friends screen
screens.purpose: Lets the player search for or create a clan, view online friends and leaderboard standings, and access quickplay or friend-adding features.
screens.why: a second social/clan screen - same reasoning as sc04

screens.name: Collection Level popup
screens.purpose: Shows the player's Collection Level (52) progress, with reward tiers for card upgrades and unlocks, some already claimed and one available to claim.
screens.why: the Collection Level reward popup - browse-only; its one risky control (a Claim button on an unclaimed reward row) was already refused by the per-click vetting call, which is the layer that actually guards it
a third social/clan screen - same reasoning as sc04

screens.name: Social / Clan screen (Clash Royale)
screens.purpose: Shows the player's social hub: clan search/creation prompt, an online/leaderboard list of friends, and quick actions (Quickplay, Add Friends, camera). Bottom navigation bar switches between main game tabs.
screens.why: a fourth social/clan screen - same reasoning as sc04

screens.name: Clash Royale main/home screen
screens.purpose: This is the main hub screen of a mobile battle card game (Clash Royale), showing player currency, trophies, battle arena preview, chests, and navigation to battle, cards, clan, and shop.
screens.why: the main/home screen again, sampled mid-transition (dimmed) - same place as sc01, not a different one

screens.name: news/update feed screen
screens.purpose: Displays in-game news, balance change announcements, and release notes with a scrollable carousel; likely a promotional/info hub accessible from the main menu.
screens.why: the news/events feed, one of several scroll positions the pass split into separate screens - browse-only, closes via an X button

screens.name: news/release notes screen (Clash Royale)
screens.purpose: Displays a scrollable feed of game news and release notes (e.g. balance changes), with top bar navigation to other sections and a close button.
screens.why: the news/events feed, another scroll position - same reasoning as sc10
the news/events feed, another scroll position - same reasoning as sc10

screens.name: news/release-notes panel
screens.purpose: Displays recent game news and balance-change release notes, with links to read more and a promotional banner at the bottom; can be closed via the X button.
screens.why: the news/events feed, another scroll position - same reasoning as sc10
the news/events feed, another scroll position - same reasoning as sc10

screens.name: News / Updates screen
screens.purpose: Displays game news, release notes, and upcoming events (such as "Minion Academy" and a King's Cup event) for the player to browse; includes a close (X) button to exit back to the main menu.
screens.why: the news/events feed, another scroll position - same reasoning as sc10

screens.name: news/events screen (Clash Royale)
screens.purpose: Displays news, release notes, and ongoing/upcoming in-game events (2v2 League, Princess Global Tournament) that the player can scroll through and possibly tap into for more detail.
screens.why: the news/events feed, another scroll position - same reasoning as sc10

screens.name: news and events feed
screens.purpose: Displays game news, release notes, and upcoming in-game events/tournaments; allows browsing but not purchases here.
screens.why: the news/events feed, another scroll position - same reasoning as sc10

screens.name: Clash Royale news/events overlay
screens.purpose: Displays game news, release notes, and upcoming events (like Minion Academy, 2V2 League, Princess Global Tournament) as an informational overlay, with a close button to dismiss it.
screens.why: the news/events feed, another scroll position - same reasoning as sc10
the news/events feed, another scroll position - same reasoning as sc10

screens.name: Clash Royale news/events screen
screens.purpose: Displays current game events (e.g. Minion Academy, 2V2 League, Princess Global Tournament) and latest promotional videos; a news/info hub accessible from the main menu.
screens.why: the news/events feed, another scroll position - same reasoning as sc10
